paper_title: Prometheus 2 An Open Source Language Model Specialized in Evaluating   Other Language Models
caption: When merging models, the influence of relative evaluation on absolute evaluation is greater than the influence of absolute evaluation on relative evaluation. Performance of Direct Assessment (colored in green) and Pairwise Ranking (colored in blue) when altering the value to merge evaluator LMs trained on different formats.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of Direct Assessment and Pairwise Ranking when merging models with varying ratios of evaluator language models trained on different formats. The x-axis represents the Direct Assessment: Pairwise Ranking merging ratio with a linear scale, ranging from 1:9 to 9:1, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The left y-axis represents Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation with a linear scale, ranging from 0.500 to 0.675, while the right y-axis represents Pairwise Ranking Agreement Accuracy with a linear scale, ranging from 50 to 80. The plot shows three lines: a green line representing Direct Assessment Correlation with square markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 0.505 and ending at around 0.625; a blue line representing Pairwise Ranking Accuracy with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 0.665 and ending at around 0.525; and a black line representing Average Performance with square markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 0.575 and ending at around 0.545. The green line increases from 0.505 to a peak around 0.675 at a 5:5 ratio, then decreases to 0.625. The blue line remains steady around 0.665 until a 5:5 ratio, then sharply declines to 0.525. The black line increases from 0.575 to a peak around 0.625 at a 5:5 ratio, then decreases to 0.545.
